title: Eighteenmile 2023 — review of original field, laboratory and outcome evidence
purpose: Internal scientific and delivery review of the original Eighteenmile 2023 lake observations and their selected descriptive outcome analysis before the Ecosystem Sciences project discussion. Review the retained methods, source support, interpretation and complete report presentation for the stated purpose.

requirements.title: Original field and laboratory records
requirements.detail: Check the original 88 lake-sample rows for SV-838, SV-839 and SV-840 against their retained source identities, applied plan revision and report coverage. Distinguish the 82 numeric results and six censored results from broader regional or campaign datasets. Treat the outcome as an analysis of these original records, rather than an independent measurement campaign.

requirements.title: Analytical methods, units and reporting limits
requirements.detail: Keep chlorophyll-a method 445.0 and microcystin methods 520019 and 520011 in their actual source groups, with original units, fraction, basis, QA and method context. Preserve Lower Reporting Limit as its original reported limit type. Review interval arithmetic, open endpoints and the explicitly selected physical lower bound; do not substitute a reporting-limit fraction for censored values.

requirements.title: Original dates and time references
requirements.detail: Use each original activity collected_at timestamp and its retained timezone offset. Preserve the August 24 microcystin dates and September 5 chlorophyll dates as separate actual dates; a matching station or clock time does not make them the same sampling event. Confirm the selected analysis timezone and same-date pairing are stated.

requirements.title: Descriptive periods and selected comparison sites
requirements.detail: Review the authored April 1–June 30 versus July 1–October 31, 2023 comparison with SV-838 as the selected analysis site and SV-840 as the reference site, if those are the actual saved selection. Check that the report states the selection explicitly and presents descriptive differences without implying a documented intervention or causal assignment.

requirements.title: Sample support, paired dates and common months
requirements.detail: Review actual record counts, numeric/censored/unresolved support, site-day aggregation, equal day weighting, QA selection and fixed-control pairing. Direct and paired effects must retain their distinct support. The selected April–June and July–October windows have no common calendar months; their common-month balanced comparison must be unavailable, rather than replaced by a different seasonal contrast.

requirements.title: Complete original figures and effect interpretation
requirements.detail: Check every saved outcome SVG and numeric figure specification alongside the original tables. Preserve full-support interval summaries separately from quantified-only summaries, and retain unavailable or unbounded effects with their actual meaning. Figure captions and tables must identify the original site, method/unit group and sampling support.

requirements.title: Ordered source context and geography
requirements.detail: Keep the original field/laboratory source first and append the saved outcome source in its actual order. Preserve their source collection IDs, member hashes, plan revision and selection. Describe Eighteenmile as the original regional study context; do not label these lake observations as measurements from the distinct four-focus utility contributing catchments.

requirements.title: Report, original data and reusable delivery
requirements.detail: Open the complete report HTML/PDF, figures, source records and selected file links in the offline package. Confirm the restored Workspace reopens the same report edition, source order and review request. Record any requested changes through the existing review response and worklist.

notes: Authored internal review request for the original Eighteenmile 2023 source and saved outcome workflow.
The actual retained outcome catalogue and selection determine the reviewed periods, groups, sites and support; the questions above must be checked against that saved edition.
